about_the_game:
Step into a world that you and your party build as you play. In LiveTale, there’s no GM—just a sandbox of tools to craft characters, weave their relationships, and spark wild events in real time. Will your next session end in triumph… or glorious chaos? Yeah, probably chaos.

The modular avatar and costume system lets you design one-of-a-kind heroes who stand out on any adventure. Bring your character to life with webcam motion capture and facial tracking—raise eyebrows, strike poses, and deliver that perfect dramatic flair. Don’t forget to turn on real-time voice modulation so that you actually sound like the brooding rogue or mischievous elf you’ve always wanted to become.

Build your world with a library full of props, items, buildings, and environments—each with unique properties and actions. Set the stage before your adventure begins, or shape the world on the fly with your party. Whether planning ahead or creating in the moment, world-building is all part of the fun!

Characters naturally spark tensions based on their personalities and charisma. Turn those sparks into one-way or mutual connections—whether as rivals, mentors, or lovers. These relationships influence conflicts, emotions, and even trigger new events, making every connection part of the unfolding adventure.

Create dynamic adventures with fully customizable event cards that shape the story in real-time. Event cards trigger encounters, quests, and twists based on player actions and choices. With this modular system, every adventure unfolds dynamically, adapting to the unexpected!

content_descriptors.notes: While there is no explicit mature content that ships with the game, it is a content creation platform aimed at users 18 years old or older, and users may create content that other users can play through, which can include mature themes.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 14.7.1 or newer
  • Processor: Apple M1
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Webcam required
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 14.7.1 or newer
  • Processor: Apple M1 Pro or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 Pro or better
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Webcam and earphone required
